title: Why a Rainbow Is Never in One Place
topic_key: rainbow refraction reflection observer position sunlight water droplets

age_layers.children: Follow one bright sunbeam into a raindrop and back to a rainbow.
age_layers.family: See the clear chain of sunlight, water droplets, reflection, and where the viewer stands.
age_layers.deeper: Notice that a rainbow is an optical effect: every observer receives light from a different set of droplets.

audience_promise: In fifty seconds, viewers see why a rainbow needs sunlight, water droplets, and the viewer's own position.
wonder_hook: Why can two people look at the same rain and never see exactly the same rainbow?

growth_plan.hook_line: A rainbow is not hanging in one place in the sky.
growth_plan.retention_promise: Each five-second scene follows one clear step: sunlight, a raindrop, reflection, colour, and the viewer's position.
growth_plan.follow_reason: Follow AION for one clear visual answer to the next everyday mystery.
growth_plan.series_angle: A new all-ages 3D storytelling experiment: one natural wonder, one visual chain, no filler.
growth_plan.editing_rule: Every scene introduces a new visible step; no repeated scenic shots, silent beats, or unrelated AION poses.

uncertainty_boundary: The visible rainbow changes with each observer's position and local light and droplet conditions; this episode explains the common primary rainbow, not every optical effect in the sky.

visual_style.summary: Original warm 3D educational storytelling: simple readable staging, rounded appealing forms, tactile natural materials, and gentle cinematic light. It is AION's own visual language and never imitates a named studio, artist, franchise, or existing work.

visual_direction.aion_presence_rationale: Light, water droplets, the landscape, and the viewer's position tell the story. AION appears only briefly as a small field guide.

visual_identity.character: AION is an original adult animated field guide with silver-white hair, natural light skin, a charcoal-black practical explorer suit, and one small cyan crystal pin at the collar. AION is never a hologram or a full-blue character.
visual_identity.environment: Original warm family-friendly 3D animated environments with coherent perspective, readable action, and realistic material texture.
